{{Quote|Now I can thank you personally for selling my weapons to Boss Caylagos.|Boss Shon Ti'Ja mentions Caylagos to Rook Pryce|<ref name="SC">''[[The Clone Wars: The Smuggler's Code]]''</ref>}}
'''Caylagos''' was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] who operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Wielu]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. At one time the infamous [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]] worked with Caylagos, and sold a number of weapons to the crime boss which belonged to a rival criminal boss, a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] named [[Shon Ti'Ja]].<ref name="SC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Caylagos was first mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: The Smuggler's Code]]'', a digest sized [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] released in [[2013]] and written by [[Justin Aclin]].
